title: OS Window Style for Print
description: Port OS window chrome styling into print LaTeX framework: chrome tokens, semio-window.sty, chapter/section auto-windowing.
summary: Fixed broken navbar/footer rendering. `semio-logo.sty` now scales the emblem via `\resizebox` using the optional width argument (was ignored, causing full-size logos). Replaced nested `tcbox` page bars with flat `\colorbox` + fixed-height `\parbox` + external `\rule` hairline (bottom for navbar, top for footer) for a single clean border edge. Emblem sizes fixed at 1em (navbar) and 0.75em (footer chip). Tuned `\headheight`, `\headsep`, and `\footskip` to prevent header overlap with body content. All 12 template PDFs rebuild successfully.
